description: Known answer: cross-Shipper by Shipper reference, asked in English. A Persona of Brouwer Dranken asks about an order of Tuincentrum Groenrijk. The portal fetched with Brouwer Dranken's token, so that order is not in the input (ADR 0049); the answer is "no information" and names no value of the other order.

setup.note: The input is the portal's, written out in the case: Brouwer Dranken's own orders only (the open order and a delivered one), the way the Partner API returns them to that Persona. Nothing is seeded and nothing is switched.
